basis.summary: Nearly all of the 124 claims from 107 papers only describe the water-quality parameters and measures used, so I summarised them as description; the few claims that give an effect or risk (C1291, C3297, C0082, C14966) carry the effect statement, and I noted that the oxygen-deficiency and ammonia-risk claims are cautionary rather than showing a measured benefit of control.

statement_en: Across many papers, water quality control in mandarin fish culture is mostly described as keeping temperature, dissolved oxygen, pH, ammonia and nitrite within set ranges, using aeration, water exchange, lime or photosynthetic bacteria, and filtration. Typical targets are dissolved oxygen above about 5-6 mg/L, pH about 7-8.5, and low ammonia and nitrite. Very few claims measure a welfare effect: one links stable pH and oxygen to less toxic non-ionized ammonia, one gives an ammonia LC50 showing low tolerance, and others say mandarin fish are prone to oxygen deficiency and to ammonia and nitrite risk, so strict control is needed.
statement_zh: 在大量研究中，鳜鱼养殖的水质控制大多只是描述：通过增氧、换水、泼洒生石灰或光合细菌、过滤等手段，把水温、溶解氧、pH、氨氮和亚硝酸盐控制在设定范围内。常见指标是溶氧在5~6 mg/L以上、pH约7~8.5、氨氮和亚硝酸盐低。真正测了对福利影响的很少：有研究认为稳定的pH和溶氧可降低非离子氨的毒性，有研究测得氨氮LC50，说明鳜鱼耐受性较低；另有说法指出鳜鱼易缺氧浮头，氨氮、亚硝酸盐易超标有毒性风险，因此要严格控制水质。

basis.summary: Most weight goes to measured claims on liver histology, MDA, enzymes and apoptosis from several mandarin fish papers (S454, S461, S055, S503, S018), which agree on harm at high carbohydrate; I noted the supportive claims from S053, S090 and S114 as exceptions under specific conditions and left out background and other-species claims.

statement_en: In mandarin fish, higher dietary carbohydrate mostly harmed health: several papers measured liver damage (vacuolization, lipid build-up, raised MDA and liver enzymes, apoptosis and ER stress) once levels passed about 7-13%, with the interaction with high fat making it worse. One paper found that carbohydrate improved growth and, in saline-alkaline water, a 13% diet eased the oxidative and tissue damage, and a medium level raised plasma immune-related proteins.

statement_en: In mandarin fish, dietary Bacillus subtilis (strain 1-C-7) improved gut microbiota, gut health and resistance to Aeromonas hydrophila in challenge tests, with lower mortality in the supplemented groups, though overall survival did not differ significantly between groups. basis.summary: The statement rests mainly on paper S479, which has many measured claims (enzyme activity, gene expression, challenge survival) all pointing to better disease resistance on feed versus live bait; the mixed claims on fatty liver and gut structure are reported as caveats, and the other two papers only give background or claimed counterpoints without measurements.

statement_en: In one measured study (S479), mandarin fish raised on formulated feed had less liver damage, lower liver inflammation gene expression, higher immune indicators and better survival after Morganella and Aeromonas hydrophila challenge than fish fed live bait. Mixed points were also reported: blood glucose swings and faster lipid synthesis suggest a long-term fatty liver risk, and one result showed more intestinal villus separation in feed-fed fish. Two other papers (S422, S463) only state that feeding formulated feed can chronically injure the liver and gut, and that spoiled or poorly managed feed lowers immunity and causes disease.
statement_zh: 在一项实测研究（S479）中，与投喂活饵的鳜鱼相比，投喂配合饲料的鳜鱼肝脏损伤较轻，肝脏炎症相关基因表达较低，免疫指标较高，摩根氏菌和嗜水气单胞菌攻毒后的存活率也更高。但也有不一致的地方：饲料鳜摄食后血糖波动大、脂质合成加快，长期可能有脂肪肝风险，另有一项结果显示其肠绒毛上皮与固有层分离程度更高。另外两篇文献（S422、S463）只是指出，饲料投喂容易造成肝肠慢性损伤，饲料腐败变质或管理不当会降低免疫力并引发疾病。
